question: How many female patients who came at the hospital in 1997 was immediately followed at the outpatient clinic?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Source table: 'patient' (no joins required) --- Filters - 'patient.SEX' = 'F' - year part of 'patient.Description' = 1997 - 'patient.Admission' = '-' --- Aggregation & Computation - Calculate 'female_patient_count' = Count of rows that satisfy all filter conditions --- Return - female_patient_count
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分错误：需求中要求'year part of patient.Description = 1997'，但SQL使用STR_TO_DATE(Description, '%Y-%m-%d')假设Description是日期字符串，而需求未说明Description字段格式，且原始问题中'came at the hospital in 1997'应指Admission时间而非Description。此外，Admission='-'在需求中用于表示某种状态，但结合原始问题语义，可能Admission字段才应包含日期信息，此处存在字段误用风险。
original_executable_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count FROM patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(Description, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 1997 AND Admission = '-';
fixed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count FROM patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '-' AND YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(Admission, '%Y-%m-%d')) = 1997;

question: The oldest SJS patient's medical laboratory work was completed on what date, and what age was the patient when they initially arrived at the hospital?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'patient' and 'laboratory' tables using 'ID' --- Filters - 'patient.Diagnosis' = 'SJS' --- Aggregation & Computation - For each SJS patient, identify that patient's earliest laboratory work date: 'min_lab_date_per_patient' = minimum value of 'laboratory.Date' grouped by 'laboratory.ID' - Among all SJS patients, find the overall earliest laboratory work date: 'oldest_lab_date' = minimum value of 'min_lab_date_per_patient' - Identify the patient (or patients) whose 'min_lab_date_per_patient' = 'oldest_lab_date' - For that patient, calculate 'age_at_first_arrival' as the difference in years between 'patient.First Date' and 'patient.Birthday' (i.e., year part of 'patient.First Date' - year part of 'patient.Birthday') --- Return - 'oldest_lab_date' (the earliest 'laboratory.Date' for SJS patients) - 'age_at_first_arrival' for the patient whose lab work corresponds to 'oldest_lab_date'
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：SQL使用了LIMIT 1和ORDER BY来试图获取最早日期对应的患者，但未正确实现‘找出所有SJS患者中最早实验室日期对应的所有患者’的逻辑。当存在多个患者具有相同的oldest_lab_date时，ANY_VALUE可能返回非对应患者的age_at_first_arrival；此外，应先确定oldest_lab_date，再关联回原表获取对应患者的年龄，而不是在同一个聚合查询中混合处理。
original_executable_sql: SELECT      MIN(lab_dates.min_lab_date) AS oldest_lab_date,      ANY_VALUE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.Birthday, p.`First Date`)) AS age_at_first_arrival  FROM patient p  JOIN (     SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS min_lab_date      FROM laboratory      GROUP BY ID ) lab_dates ON p.ID = lab_dates.ID  WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'  ORDER BY lab_dates.min_lab_date ASC  LIMIT 1;
fixed_sql: SELECT      oldest.oldest_lab_date,     TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.Birthday, p.`First Date`) AS age_at_first_arrival FROM patient p JOIN (     SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS min_lab_date     FROM laboratory     GROUP BY ID ) lab_dates ON p.ID = lab_dates.ID JOIN (     SELECT MIN(lab_dates_inner.min_lab_date) AS oldest_lab_date     FROM patient p_inner     JOIN (         SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS min_lab_date         FROM laboratory         GROUP BY ID     ) lab_dates_inner ON p_inner.ID = lab_dates_inner.ID     WHERE p_inner.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ) oldest ON lab_dates.min_lab_date = oldest.oldest_lab_date WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS';

question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'patient' and 'laboratory' tables using 'ID' --- Filters - None beyond join condition; consider all laboratory examinations --- Aggregation & Computation - For each record in 'laboratory', compute 'age_at_exam' = year part of 'laboratory.Date' - year part of 'patient.Birthday' - Identify 'max_hgb' = maximum value of 'laboratory.HGB' across all joined records - Select the record(s) where 'laboratory.HGB' = 'max_hgb' --- Return - age_at_exam (age of the patient at the time of the examination with the highest hemoglobin count) - patient.Diagnosis (doctor's diagnosis for that patient)
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：未在所有已连接的记录中计算max_hgb，而是直接在laboratory表中选取MAX(HGB)，忽略了可能因JOIN导致的记录变化；此外，未处理可能存在多个相同max_hgb值的情况，使用LIMIT 1会任意丢弃其他有效结果
original_executable_sql: SELECT      YEAR(l.Date) - YEAR(p.Birthday) AS age_at_exam,     p.Diagnosis FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM laboratory) LIMIT 1;
fixed_sql: SELECT      YEAR(l.Date) - YEAR(p.Birthday) AS age_at_exam,     p.Diagnosis FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.HGB = (     SELECT MAX(l2.HGB)     FROM patient p2     JOIN laboratory l2 ON p2.ID = l2.ID );

question: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'patient' and 'laboratory' tables using 'ID' --- Filters - year part of 'laboratory.Date' = 1984 - Age at the time of query: (year part of current timestamp - year part of 'patient.Birthday') < 50 - 'laboratory.PLT' >= 100 - 'laboratory.PLT' <= 400 --- Return - Distinct 'patient.ID' - 'patient.Birthday' - 'laboratory.Date' - 'laboratory.PLT'
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分错误：年龄计算应基于当前时间戳而非实验室检查日期，需求中为'(year part of current timestamp - year part of 'patient.Birthday') < 50'，但SQL使用了TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.Birthday, l.Date) < 50
original_executable_sql: SELECT DISTINCT      p.ID,      p.Birthday,      l.Date,      l.PLT FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = 1984   AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.Birthday, l.Date) < 50   AND l.PLT >= 100   AND l.PLT <= 400;
fixed_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.PLT FROM patient p JOIN laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = 1984   AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(p.Birthday)) < 50   AND l.PLT >= 100   AND l.PLT <= 400;

question: List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'team_attributes' and 'team' using 'team_attributes.team_api_id' = 'team.team_api_id' --- Filters - Year part of 'team_attributes.date' = 2012 - 'team_attributes.buildUpPlayPassing' IS NOT NULL --- Aggregation & Computation - Calculate 'avg_buildUpPlayPassing_2012' = SUM('team_attributes.buildUpPlayPassing') / COUNT('team.team_long_name') over all records that satisfy the Filters - For each joined record, keep only those where 'team_attributes.buildUpPlayPassing' > 'avg_buildUpPlayPassing_2012' --- Return - Distinct 'team.team_long_name'
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：需求要求计算 avg_buildUpPlayPassing_2012 为 SUM(team_attributes.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(team.team_long_name)，但SQL中使用的是 AVG(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing)，二者在存在重复 team_api_id 或多对一关联时可能不等价；此外，COUNT 应基于满足过滤条件的 joined 记录中的 team.team_long_name，而子查询未涉及 team 表，导致分母逻辑不一致 | 尝试修正但引入了执行错误: 1054 (42S22): Unknown column 'ta.buildUpPlayPlayPassing' in 'where clause'
original_executable_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM team_attributes ta JOIN team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE YEAR(ta.date) = 2012   AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL   AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (     SELECT AVG(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing)     FROM team_attributes ta2     WHERE YEAR(ta2.date) = 2012       AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL   );
fixed_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name FROM team_attributes ta JOIN team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id WHERE YEAR(ta.date) = 2012   AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL   AND ta.buildUpPlayPlayPassing > (     SELECT SUM(ta2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(t2.team_long_name)     FROM team_attributes ta2     JOIN team t2 ON ta2.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id     WHERE YEAR(ta2.date) = 2012       AND ta2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL   );

unimplemented_reason: Filters部分存在字段拼写错误：'CreaionDate' 应为 'CreationDate' | 尝试修正但引入了执行错误: 1054 (42S22): Unknown column 'p.CreationDate' in 'where clause'

question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'posts' and 'users' tables using 'posts.OwnerUserId' = 'users.Id' --- Filters - year part of 'posts.CreaionDate' = 2011 --- Aggregation & Computation - Calculate 'total_posts_2011' = Count of 'posts.Id' where year part of 'posts.CreaionDate' = 2011 - Calculate 'high_rep_posts_2011' = Count of 'posts.Id' where year part of 'posts.CreaionDate' = 2011 and 'users.Reputation' > 1000 - Calculate 'percentage' = ('high_rep_posts_2011' / 'total_posts_2011') * 100 --- Return - percentage
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分存在字段拼写错误：SQL中使用了'p.CreaionDate'，而需求中指定的字段应为'posts.CreationDate'（缺少't'） | 尝试修正但引入了执行错误: 1054 (42S22): Unknown column 'p.CreationDate' in 'where clause'
original_executable_sql: SELECT      (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage FROM      posts p JOIN      users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE      YEAR(p.CreaionDate) = 2011;
fixed_sql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE YEAR(p.CreationDate) = 2011;

question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'customers' and 'yearmonth' tables using 'CustomerID' --- Filters - year part of 'yearmonth.Date' = 2012 (i.e., 'yearmonth.Date' between '201201' and '201212') --- Aggregation & Computation - Calculate 'total_consumption_CZK' = Sum of 'yearmonth.Consumption' where 'customers.Currency' = 'CZK' - Calculate 'total_consumption_EUR' = Sum of 'yearmonth.Consumption' where 'customers.Currency' = 'EUR' - Calculate 'difference_consumption' = 'total_consumption_CZK' - 'total_consumption_EUR' --- Return - difference_consumption
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分错误：需求中要求yearmonth.Date在'201201'到'201212'之间，而SQL中使用了'2012-01-01'到'2012-12-31'，假设yearmonth.Date是YYYYMM格式（如201201），则SQL的BETWEEN条件不匹配该格式，会导致过滤失效或错误
original_executable_sql: SELECT      SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -      SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS difference_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31';
fixed_sql: SELECT      SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -      SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS difference_consumption  FROM customers c  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID  WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212';

question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'customers' and 'yearmonth' tables using 'CustomerID' --- Filters - 'customers.Currency' = 'EUR' - year part of 'yearmonth.Date' IN (2012, 2013) - 'customers.Segment' IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') --- Aggregation & Computation - For each combination of 'customers.Segment' and year part of 'yearmonth.Date': - Calculate 'total_consumption_year' = SUM('yearmonth.Consumption') - Reshape the aggregated data so that for each 'customers.Segment' there is one row with: - 'consumption_2012' = total_consumption_year where year part of 'yearmonth.Date' = 2012 - 'consumption_2013' = total_consumption_year where year part of 'yearmonth.Date' = 2013 - For each 'customers.Segment': - Calculate 'increase_or_decrease' = consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 - Calculate 'percentage_increase' = (increase_or_decrease / consumption_2013) * 100 - Identify: - 'segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase' = segment where 'percentage_increase' is the maximum among SME, LAM, KAM - 'segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase' = segment where 'percentage_increase' is the minimum among SME, LAM, KAM --- Ordering & Limit - Order intermediate result by 'percentage_increase' in descending order when searching for the biggest percentage increase - Order intermediate result by 'percentage_increase' in ascending order when searching for the lowest percentage increase - Limit to 1 row for the biggest percentage increase and 1 row for the lowest percentage increase --- Return - segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase - percentage_increase for segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase - segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase - percentage_increase for segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：percentage_increase的计算公式应为(increase_or_decrease / consumption_2013) * 100，但SQL中使用了consumption_2012作为分母
original_executable_sql: WITH segment_consumption AS (     SELECT          c.Segment,         YEAR(ym.Date) AS year_val,         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption     FROM customers c     JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID     WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'       AND YEAR(ym.Date) IN (2012, 2013)       AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')     GROUP BY c.Segment, YEAR(ym.Date) ), pivoted_data AS (     SELECT          Segment,         MAX(CASE WHEN year_val = 2012 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,         MAX(CASE WHEN year_val = 2013 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2013     FROM segment_consumption     GROUP BY Segment ), percentage_calc AS (     SELECT          Segment,         consumption_2012,         consumption_2013,         (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase_or_decrease,         (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 1.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) * 100 AS percentage_increase     FROM pivoted_data     WHERE consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL AND consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL ), biggest_increase AS (     SELECT          Segment AS segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase,         percentage_increase AS biggest_percentage_increase     FROM percentage_calc     ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC     LIMIT 1 ), lowest_increase AS (     SELECT          Segment AS segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase,         percentage_increase AS lowest_percentage_increase     FROM percentage_calc     ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC     LIMIT 1 ) SELECT      b.segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase,     b.biggest_percentage_increase,     l.segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase,     l.lowest_percentage_increase FROM biggest_increase b CROSS JOIN lowest_increase l;
fixed_sql: WITH segment_consumption AS (     SELECT         c.Segment,         YEAR(ym.Date) AS year_val,         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption     FROM customers c     JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID     WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'       AND YEAR(ym.Date) IN (2012, 2013)       AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')     GROUP BY c.Segment, YEAR(ym.Date) ), pivoted_data AS (     SELECT         Segment,         MAX(CASE WHEN year_val = 2012 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2012,         MAX(CASE WHEN year_val = 2013 THEN total_consumption END) AS consumption_2013     FROM segment_consumption     GROUP BY Segment ), percentage_calc AS (     SELECT         Segment,         consumption_2012,         consumption_2013,         (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase_or_decrease,         (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 1.0 / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0) * 100 AS percentage_increase     FROM pivoted_data     WHERE consumption_2012 IS NOT NULL AND consumption_2013 IS NOT NULL ), biggest_increase AS (     SELECT         Segment AS segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase,         percentage_increase AS biggest_percentage_increase     FROM percentage_calc     ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC     LIMIT 1 ), lowest_increase AS (     SELECT         Segment AS segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase,         percentage_increase AS lowest_percentage_increase     FROM percentage_calc     ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC     LIMIT 1 ) SELECT     b.segment_with_biggest_percentage_increase,     b.biggest_percentage_increase,     l.segment_with_lowest_percentage_increase,     l.lowest_percentage_increase FROM biggest_increase b CROSS JOIN lowest_increase l;

question: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'player' and 'player_attributes' tables using 'player.player_api_id' = 'player_attributes.player_api_id' --- Aggregation & Computation - For each player, calculate 'avg_finishing' = AVG('player_attributes.finishing') grouped by 'player.player_api_id' - Identify 'max_height' = MAX('player.height') across all players - Identify 'min_height' = MIN('player.height') across all players - Among players with 'player.height' = 'max_height', calculate 'highest_avg_finishing_tall' = MAX('avg_finishing') - Among players with 'player.height' = 'min_height', calculate 'highest_avg_finishing_short' = MAX('avg_finishing') - Compare 'highest_avg_finishing_tall' and 'highest_avg_finishing_short' and select the greater value; if needed, return the corresponding player(s) --- Return - Distinct 'player.player_api_id' of the player(s) with the highest value between 'highest_avg_finishing_tall' and 'highest_avg_finishing_short' - Corresponding 'player.height' - Corresponding 'avg_finishing'
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分未完全实现：需求要求先分别计算最高身高和最矮身高中各自的最高avg_finishing（即highest_avg_finishing_tall和highest_avg_finishing_short），再比较这两个值选出更大的一方；但SQL直接在所有最高和最矮身高球员中找全局最高的avg_finishing，未区分tall和short两组分别取最大后再比较。
original_executable_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.player_api_id, p.height, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing FROM player p JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM player)    OR p.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM player) GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.height HAVING avg_finishing = (     SELECT MAX(avg_fin)     FROM (         SELECT AVG(pa1.finishing) AS avg_fin         FROM player p1         JOIN player_attributes pa1 ON p1.player_api_id = pa1.player_api_id         WHERE p1.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM player)            OR p1.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM player)         GROUP BY p1.player_api_id     ) AS t );
fixed_sql: WITH PlayerAvgFinishing AS (     SELECT          p.player_api_id,         p.height,         AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing     FROM player p     JOIN player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id     GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.height ), HeightExtremes AS (     SELECT          MAX(height) AS max_height,         MIN(height) AS min_height     FROM player ), TallPlayers AS (     SELECT          paf.player_api_id,         paf.height,         paf.avg_finishing     FROM PlayerAvgFinishing paf     CROSS JOIN HeightExtremes he     WHERE paf.height = he.max_height ), ShortPlayers AS (     SELECT          paf.player_api_id,         paf.height,         paf.avg_finishing     FROM PlayerAvgFinishing paf     CROSS JOIN HeightExtremes he     WHERE paf.height = he.min_height ), MaxFinishingTall AS (     SELECT MAX(avg_finishing) AS highest_avg_finishing_tall     FROM TallPlayers ), MaxFinishingShort AS (     SELECT MAX(avg_finishing) AS highest_avg_finishing_short     FROM ShortPlayers ), TargetValue AS (     SELECT          CASE              WHEN COALESCE(mft.highest_avg_finishing_tall, -1) >= COALESCE(mfs.highest_avg_finishing_short, -1)             THEN mft.highest_avg_finishing_tall             ELSE mfs.highest_avg_finishing_short         END AS target_avg_finishing     FROM MaxFinishingTall mft     CROSS JOIN MaxFinishingShort mfs ) SELECT DISTINCT      paf.player_api_id,     paf.height,     paf.avg_finishing FROM PlayerAvgFinishing paf JOIN TargetValue tv ON paf.avg_finishing = tv.target_avg_finishing WHERE paf.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM player)    OR paf.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM player);

question: How many French drivers who obtain the laptime less than 02:00.00?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'drivers' and 'laptimes' tables using 'driverId' --- Filters - 'drivers.nationality' = 'French' - Convert 'laptimes.time' to total seconds and keep rows where total seconds < 120 (lap time less than 02:00.00) --- Aggregation & Computation - Calculate 'french_drivers_under_2min' = Count of DISTINCT 'drivers.driverId' that satisfy the filters --- Return - french_drivers_under_2min
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分错误：时间转换逻辑不正确。需求要求将'laptimes.time'转换为总秒数，但SQL中对分钟和秒的解析方式有误。对于格式如'MM:SS.MS'的时间字符串，SUBSTRING_INDEX(l.time, ':', -2)在只有1个冒号时会返回整个字符串，导致秒部分解析错误。
original_executable_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS french_drivers_under_2min FROM drivers d JOIN laptimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'French'   AND (     CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(l.time, ':', 1) AS UNSIGNED) * 60 +     CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(l.time, ':', -2), '.', 1) AS UNSIGNED) +     CAST(CONCAT('0.', SUBSTRING_INDEX(l.time, '.', -1)) AS DECIMAL(10,3))   ) < 120;

question: State code numbers of top 3 yougest drivers. How many Netherlandic drivers among them?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Source table: 'drivers' (no joins required) --- Filters - Exclude records where 'drivers.dob' is NULL (only consider drivers with known date of birth) --- Aggregation & Computation - For each driver, derive 'birth_year' = year part of 'drivers.dob' - Order all drivers by 'birth_year' in descending order (larger year = younger), and if needed by 'drivers.dob' in descending order to break ties (later date = younger) - Select the first 3 rows from this ordered list (top 3 youngest drivers) - Among these 3 selected drivers, count how many have 'drivers.nationality' corresponding to Netherlands (including values like 'Dutch' or 'Netherlandic', as they refer to the same country) --- Ordering & Limit - Order by year part of 'drivers.dob' DESC, then by 'drivers.dob' DESC - Limit to 3 rows --- Return - 'drivers.code' for each of the top 3 youngest drivers - 'netherlandic_count' = number of drivers among the top 3 whose nationality is Netherlands/Dutch/Netherlandic
unimplemented_reason: Return部分错误：要求返回每个司机的code以及一个总的netherlandic_count，但当前SQL对每一行都重复返回相同的netherlandic_count，而需求隐含的是在结果集中附加一个聚合统计值；此外，Aggregation部分未明确要求使用窗口函数，且按自然语义应先选出top 3再统计其中荷兰籍人数，而非在每行计算全局总和
original_executable_sql: SELECT      d.code,     SUM(CASE WHEN d.nationality IN ('Netherlands', 'Dutch', 'Netherlandic') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS netherlandic_count FROM drivers d WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY YEAR(d.dob) DESC, d.dob DESC LIMIT 3;
fixed_sql: SELECT      d.code,     (SELECT COUNT(*)       FROM (          SELECT nationality           FROM drivers           WHERE dob IS NOT NULL           ORDER BY YEAR(dob) DESC, dob DESC           LIMIT 3      ) AS top3       WHERE top3.nationality IN ('Netherlands', 'Dutch', 'Netherlandic')     ) AS netherlandic_count FROM drivers d WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY YEAR(d.dob) DESC, d.dob DESC LIMIT 3;

question: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Source table: 'drivers' - Link 'drivers' to 'driverstandings' using 'drivers.driverId' = 'driverstandings.driverId' - Link 'driverstandings' to 'races' using 'driverstandings.raceId' = 'races.raceId' --- Filters - Identify the youngest driver by selecting the record(s) in 'drivers' where 'dob' = the maximum value of 'drivers.dob' across all drivers --- Aggregation & Computation - For the youngest driver, find all related records in 'driverstandings' - For those records, determine the earliest race they joined by selecting the minimum value of 'races.date' - If multiple races share this same earliest date for that driver, select the one(s) with that minimum 'races.date' - Create a derived column 'full_name' = concatenation of 'drivers.forename' and 'drivers.surname' --- Ordering & Limit - When identifying the youngest driver, order drivers by 'dob' in descending order and select the top 1 (or equivalently use MAX(dob)) - When identifying the first race for that driver, order the joined races by 'races.date' in ascending order and select the top 1 --- Return - full_name (drivers.forename + drivers.surname) - drivers.nationality - races.name
unimplemented_reason: Filters部分错误：使用了子查询 WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers) 虽然逻辑上可选出最年轻车手，但未按需求说明中要求的‘order by dob desc limit 1’方式实现；更重要的是，该写法在存在多个同最大dob值的车手时会返回多条记录，而后续 ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1 会在这些多条记录中只取一个最早比赛，导致可能遗漏其他同龄最年轻车手的首场比赛。需求明确要求先确定 youngest driver（按dob降序取top 1），再找其最早比赛，而当前SQL将两个步骤混合，违反了分步处理的语义。此外，Aggregation部分未体现对‘该车手所有参赛记录中取最早比赛’的中间步骤，直接通过全局JOIN+LIMIT 1实现，不符合需求描述的两阶段逻辑。
original_executable_sql: SELECT      CONCAT(d.forename, ' ', d.surname) AS full_name,     d.nationality,     r.name AS race_name FROM drivers d JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers) ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1;
fixed_sql: SELECT      CONCAT(d.forename, ' ', d.surname) AS full_name,     d.nationality,     r.name AS race_name FROM (     SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality     FROM drivers     ORDER BY dob DESC     LIMIT 1 ) d JOIN driverstandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId ORDER BY r.date ASC LIMIT 1;

question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Link 'cards' and 'legalities' tables using 'uuid' (cards.uuid = legalities.uuid) --- Filters - 'cards.artist' = 'Allen Williams' --- Aggregation & Computation - For each card by Allen Williams, determine if it has any associated 'legalities.status' = 'Banned' - Create a derived flag or indicator column 'is_banned' that is true if at least one related legality record has status = 'Banned', otherwise false --- Return - 'cards.name' - 'cards.frameVersion' - 'cards.uuid' - 'legalities.status' (only for related records, may be null if no legality rows) - Derived column 'is_banned' indicating whether the card is banned in any format
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：GROUP BY中包含l.status导致无法正确聚合判断是否被禁；Return部分错误：返回了l.status（可能多行），但需求要求每张卡一行并附带is_banned标志
original_executable_sql: SELECT      c.name,     c.frameVersion,     c.uuid,     l.status,     IF(MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Banned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_banned FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams' GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.frameVersion, l.status;
fixed_sql: SELECT      c.name,     c.frameVersion,     c.uuid,     IF(MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Banned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_banned FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Allen Williams' GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.frameVersion;

question: For the client whose loan was approved first in 1993/7/5, what is the increase rate of his/her account balance from 1993/3/22 to 1998/12/27?
nl2_rewrite: --- Source & Joins - Source tables: 'loan', 'account', 'trans' - Link 'loan' and 'account' using 'loan.account_id' = 'account.account_id' - Link 'account' and 'trans' using 'account.account_id' = 'trans.account_id' --- Filters - For identifying the client: filter 'loan.date' = 1993-07-05 - Among loans on 1993-07-05, identify the loan with the earliest approval time on that date (if only date is stored and no time exists, treat all loans on that date as tied and select the one with the minimum 'loan.loan_id' as a deterministic tie-breaker) - After selecting that single 'loan.account_id', filter 'trans.account_id' to this account only - For balance on Date B: filter 'trans.date' = 1993-03-22 - For balance on Date A: filter 'trans.date' = 1998-12-27 --- Aggregation & Computation - For the selected account, determine 'balance_B' as the 'trans.balance' on 1993-03-22 (if multiple transactions exist on that date, use the record with the latest transaction time on that date; if time is not available, use the record with the maximum 'trans_id' on that date) - For the selected account, determine 'balance_A' as the 'trans.balance' on 1998-12-27 (same rule: if multiple records, use the one with the latest transaction on that date, or maximum 'trans_id' if no time) - Calculate 'increase_rate' = ((balance_A - balance_B) / balance_B) * 100 --- Return - increase_rate
unimplemented_reason: Aggregation部分错误：未按要求使用最新交易时间（或最大trans_id）来确定balance_A和balance_B，而是直接使用MAX(balance)，这在同一天有多条交易时无法保证选取的是最新交易的余额
original_executable_sql: SELECT ((balance_A - balance_B) * 1.0 / NULLIF(balance_B, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate FROM (     SELECT          MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_A,         MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) AS balance_B     FROM (         SELECT              l.account_id         FROM loan l         JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id         WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'         ORDER BY l.loan_id         LIMIT 1     ) target_account     JOIN trans t ON target_account.account_id = t.account_id     WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')     GROUP BY t.account_id     HAVING          MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.trans_id END) IS NOT NULL          AND MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.trans_id END) IS NOT NULL ) balances;
fixed_sql: SELECT ((balance_A - balance_B) * 1.0 / NULLIF(balance_B, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate FROM (     SELECT          (SELECT t1.balance           FROM trans t1           WHERE t1.account_id = target_account.account_id             AND t1.date = '1998-12-27'           ORDER BY t1.trans_id DESC           LIMIT 1) AS balance_A,         (SELECT t2.balance           FROM trans t2           WHERE t2.account_id = target_account.account_id             AND t2.date = '1993-03-22'           ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC           LIMIT 1) AS balance_B     FROM (         SELECT l.account_id         FROM loan l         JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id         WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'         ORDER BY l.loan_id         LIMIT 1     ) AS target_account ) AS balances WHERE balance_B IS NOT NULL AND balance_A IS NOT NULL;
